instructions.question: What sentiment does this Albanian Facebook comment on the Kosovo public health institute's COVID-19 post express: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Negative needs a strong negative emotion: horror or despair words, fed-up complaints, insults or curses, explicit claims the numbers are fake or hidden, or anger at the measures or government. Neutral is calm, reasoned or playful: questions, data requests, calculations, predictions, speculation, scolding citizens without insults, and jokes about towns, friends, the admin or the lab with no insult. Positive covers praise, thanks, blessings, relief or good news about recoveries or falling cases, and hopeful encouragement. Town pride and off-topic congratulations are neutral.

neutral.what: Calm, playful or reasoned comments: questions, data requests, calculations, speculation about undercounting, advice, criticism of citizens without insults, teasing friends about their town, jokes about the admin or lab, tags, condolences.
examples: Pse ka Mitrovica Verit nuk po jepni Rezultate hiq !? (Why aren't you giving any results for North Mitrovica!?)
Koka qu sot heret ai i laboratorit (The lab guy got up early today)
Doruntina Ademi ju vushtrria spo e lshoni koronen hiqq (You in Vushtrri won't let go of the corona at all)
Mshelni kafet! (Close the cafés!)
neutral.cues: hahaha, tagged names, pse (why), a ka (is there), duhet (should), hajde ma gjall (come on, livelier), kampion (champion), admini (the admin), ngushllime (condolences), numbers
neutral.not_for: Comments with horror words, insults, curses or claims of fake numbers are negative.

positive.what: Praise, thanks, blessings, relief that cases are falling or the virus is fading, good news about recoveries, hopeful encouraging appeals.
examples: Asllan A Haxholli A ka lajm mat mir, 35 t'sherum (Is there better news, 35 recovered)
Shyqyr qeky nxeht e nali pak viusin se ke tu na shkatrru a (Thank God this heat has slowed the virus a bit, it was ruining us)
Perhajr edhe Juve (Blessings to you too)
positive.cues: bravo, ju lumtë (well done), faleminderit (thank you), shyqyr (thank God), lajm i mirë (good news), mir asht (it's good), t'sherum (recovered), shendet (health), do e kalojm (we'll get through it), mashallah, perhajr (congratulations/blessings)
positive.not_for: Sarcastic praise is negative. 'Prishtina kampion' (Prishtina champion), 'Urime libralizimi i vizav' (congratulations on visa liberalisation) and recovery forecasts are neutral.

negative.what: Horror, despair, being fed up, insults, curses, distrust of the numbers, anger at the measures or government.
examples: 15 te vdekur, tmerr. (15 dead, horror.)
kurr ska mu ba mir me ket popull budall (It'll never get better with this stupid people)
IKSHPK mos i fshehni rezultatet Tregoni shifrat e verteta (IKSHPK, don't hide the results, show the real figures)
Na lodhet (You've worn us out)
negative.cues: tmerr (horror), mjerim (misery), kjamete (catastrophe), boll keq (bad enough), na lodhet / u lodhum (worn out), budall (stupid), qija nanen (curse), rrene (lies), fshehni (hide), palidhje (pointless), e hupi kontrollen (lost control), deshtu (failed)
negative.not_for: Reasoned arguments about testing or citizens' behaviour, and jokes about the admin or lab without insults, are neutral.
